headline: Former Party Spokesperson Vacates Post To Dedicate Time To Professional 'Professional Letter Writer' Career
body: A former prominent party spokesperson has officially resigned, citing an urgent, full-time commitment to ghostwriting polite, non-confrontational apology emails for local neighborhood WhatsApp group admins. The transition comes after the former official reportedly realized his innate talent for debating complex socio-political issues was perfectly transferable to mediating petty arguments over colony gate closure timings.
caption: The transition we all saw coming but nobody predicted. Turns out, debating on primetime is just training for the chaos of resident welfare association group chats. #CareerPivot #WhatsAppWars #SpokespersonLife (satire)
igHook: Tag a friend who would be better off mediating neighborhood drama than appearing on national TV.
